title: Jeff's Farm — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage farm resilience
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Jeff's farm sits quiet in the Zimbabwean dawn
The cattle in the paddock and the dew upon the corn
He walks the boundary fence line every morning before light
Jeff knows every corner of this land he chose to fight for

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Jeff anomuka mangwanani, anoshanda pamunda wake
[Jeff rises in the morning, he works on his farm]
Anofamba mumarenje, anotarisa zvese zvake
[He walks through the fields, he watches all his things]
Minda yake yakura, zvipfuyo zvake zvinodya
[His crops have grown, his cattle are feeding]
Jeff ane moyo wenyika, haabvisi maziso ake
[Jeff has the heart of the land, he does not look away]

[Chorus — English]
Jeff's farm, Jeff's farm
Red earth and green corn under Zimbabwean sky
Jeff's farm, Jeff's farm
He built it from nothing and he refused to say goodbye

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
IPulazi likaJeff limi ngokuzimela
[Jeff's farm stands in independence]
Wakulima umhlabathi ngesandla sakhe
[He farmed the soil with his own hand]
Imvula yamlethela impilo entsha
[The rain brought him new life]
IPulazi likaJeff lingubufakazi bothando
[Jeff's farm is evidence of love]

[Outro — All three languages]
Jeff's farm… Munda waJeff… IPulazi likaJeff
He stayed — Akasiya — Wahlala
The gardens still growing
